# CANDIDATE: NAMED_LEVEL_THIRD_TEST_BREAKOUT_WITH_VIX_TILT

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Third test of a named level (e.g., prior day high) with declining volume on approach and expanding volume on breakout, confirmed by rising VIX, indicates institutional accumulation. The pattern anticipates a breakout after two failing tests, distinct from second-test rejections or first-touch breakouts.

## Mechanism

Entry: Price approaches prior day high (PDH) within 0.08% on two consecutive candles with decreasing volume (each test volume < prior test), then third candle closes above PDH with volume > 1.6 * average volume of prior 12 candles, and current VIX > VIX 5 minutes ago (rising volatility). Exit: Stop at prior day low (PDL) or 0.5*ATR below entry, initial target at 1.5:1 reward-risk (60% position), remainder trailed by 10% of ATR from high-water mark using chart-stop at 8-day EMA. Regime filter: Time between 9:50 AM - 11:30 AM ET, VIX < 30, and avoids days with VIX change >2 points from prior close.
